correctness.rationale: For any n>=1 with at most four positive constant runs, symbol totals and mixed 2-/3-subsequence counts distinguish <=3 run types and each same-start four-run word. For w=0^a1^b0^c1^d, p=N10=bc, N010=ap and N101=dp recover a,d and then b,c. Comparing an opposite-start source with the same deck forces t=p/(AB-p)>0 and ad t(t-1)=0; positive a,d force t=1, so its unique possible partner is the reversal and requires 2bc=(a+c)(b+d). Pair-subsequence double counting shows fairness suffices for all triple-pattern equality. The fourth-deck difference N0010-N0100=abc(a-c)/2 is nonzero because fairness forces c>a; thus order4 is injective within this source family. Counting unique zero-start fair pairs with A=a+c and b gives the displayed divisibility sum F_n; all fibers have one or two elements and count T_n-F_n. The direct independently implemented DP exhaustively verified n=1..12 and F7=2,T7=84, 82 restricted distinct decks. That finite check corroborates but does not prove the all-length identity.
